reason: I got burned by a software rollout and this is a startup with the product still in development, asking me to forward supplier emails and export open POs into it. I would take the free six-week test to see if it catches anything real, but I would not commit $2,000 a month to it, and I would need IT, finance and my boss to sign off on sending our supplier data to an unproven vendor.
objection: If it misses a short ship or a backorder that our team would have caught anyway, I have paid to add a tool and a new daily routine. And I do not know yet what happens to our supplier emails and PO data once they leave our inbox.
would_change_my_mind: A six-week free test on our own open POs that catches at least a few real late or short supplier changes before my shortage meeting, plus a reference from a plant of similar size that has run it for a year.
